name: hypes
description: Adapt how much help to offer when substantive task work needs it while preserving content and responsibility.

interface.shortDescription: Adapt help when substantive work needs it
interface.longDescription: Hypes keeps a recommendation-only control and a task-local adaptive loop that is eligible whenever substantive work needs a different depth or form of help. It applies a differing strategy only after the user chooses it and can use confirmed corrections or bound outcomes on the next turn. It does not write a profile, database, or cross-conversation state.
defaultPrompt: Calculate a separate help recommendation for this task without applying it to the response.
Use Hypes whenever this task needs a different depth or form of help, and ask only when its proposal differs.
Close this Hypes task session and summarize the four outcome dimensions.
